description: Ingestion boundary v1 core. Strict numeric parsing (A5/C4): values crossing the boundary parse strictly or quarantine — thousands separators, decimal commas, currency forms, scientific notation, booleans and non-finite numbers are named quarantine reasons, never coerced. The nz()-style fallback is legal only for fields explicitly declared optional and genuinely missing. Plausibility bounds on every quantity-bearing field; the deliveries bounds-guard returns the full A5 substitution plan (quarantined value, trailing-7-day-mean baseline from valid entries only, DATA_HEALTH task, UI banner naming the substitution). Pure core: file IO, upserts, RLS and idempotency land with the M1 pipeline stages in the app layer.
